Threat & Vulnerability Description: Historical CV training data bias penalizing female applicants, older candidates 45+, and non-Western names.
Addressing Controls: Fairlearn re-weighting, proxy masking, sub-group DIR monitoring.

Threat & Vulnerability Description: Recruiters blindly approving top 5 AI candidate recommendations without meaningful human review (45-sec rubber-stamping).
Affected Fundamental Right / Safety: Right to Fair Work Conditions (EU Charter Art 31)
Addressing Controls: Mandatory 2-min UI review lock, blind initial scoring, override logging.

Threat & Vulnerability Description: White-font prompt injection in candidate PDF resumes manipulating BERT/XGBoost ranking scores.
Addressing Controls: PyMuPDF text sanitizer pre-parser, font-color filter, prompt strip rules.

Threat & Vulnerability Description: Shift in job market skill terminology over time degrading semantic matching precision.
Addressing Controls: Monthly vector embedding drift monitoring, automated performance retraining trigger.

Threat & Vulnerability Description: Extraction of sensitive candidate PII from fine-tuned BERT embeddings via membership inference attacks.
Affected Fundamental Right / Safety: Right to Protection of Personal Data (EU Charter Art 8)
Addressing Controls: Differential privacy in fine-tuning, embedding vector anonymization.

Threat & Vulnerability Description: Deployers setting system to execute fully automated candidate rejection emails without human review.
Affected Fundamental Right / Safety: Right to Good Administration (EU Charter Art 41)
Addressing Controls: Contractual ban, ATS API hard blocks preventing automated rejection triggers.

Threat & Vulnerability Description: Inability to provide clear rationale for candidate match score during regulatory audit or candidate appeal.
Affected Fundamental Right / Safety: Transparency & Right to Explanation (Art 13 & GDPR Art 22)
Addressing Controls: SHAP feature impact visualization, candidate-facing score breakdown portal.

Threat & Vulnerability Description: AWS cloud service outage disabling screening engine during major enterprise hiring campaigns.
Upstream LLM tokenization API deprecation or breaking change causing parsing errors.
Addressing Controls: Local containerized BERT models, zero external API runtime dependencies.

Threat & Vulnerability Description: Malicious candidate submitters uploading adversarial CVs designed to skew vector space clusters.
Addressing Controls: Input rate limiting, anomaly detection on vector cluster centroids.
